detail.longDescription: I’m working on a web-based touchscreen interface and need to detect multiple simultaneous touch points. I can detect basic touch events, but I’m trying to understand the best way to track each active finger separately and display its position on the screen. For example, if three fingers are touching the screen at the same time, I’d like to identify each touch point and update its position as the user moves their fingers. I’m currently looking at the browser Touch Events API, but I’m not sure whether I should use touches , targetTouches , or changedTouches for this use case. What is the recommended approach for tracking multiple simultaneous touch points in JavaScript?
